source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting set in a rocky gorge with towering cliff walls, a large gnarled pine-like tree, two seated scholar figures, a right-side stream cascade, rocky terraces, bamboo grasses, and dense ink foliage. Seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: gnarled_ancient_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant old tree spanning the left and center: thick twisting trunk rising from the lower left, knotted hollows, looping branches, and dense dark leaf clusters spreading across the middle and right.
must_preserve: sinuous ink outlines of the trunk and branches
knotted hollows and dark bark scars
dense repeated dark leaf dabs and scalloped foliage clusters

motifs.name: upper_light_leaf_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the higher, lighter-toned leafy crown above the main dark tree mass, centered near the top, with rounded flower-like clusters and fine branch structure.
must_preserve: lighter green-brown wash distinct from darker lower foliage
fine ink contouring around leaf tips

motifs.name: left_leaning_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the sloping rock wall behind the upper-left tree, excluding red seals and foreground foliage as much as possible. The form leans diagonally downward from the upper left into the central background.
must_preserve: pale brown and gray ink washes

motifs.name: right_vertical_cliff_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the tall sheer cliff on the right side, from the top down behind the trees to the lower ravine, including vertical rock planes and dark edge accents but excluding seals.
must_preserve: misty fading transitions around the tree silhouettes

motifs.name: left_seated_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the seated scholar on the left of the terrace, shown in pale robes in profile facing inward toward the musician.
must_preserve: pale robe shape with dark collar edge
small dark shoe and robe hem accents

motifs.name: central_musician_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the central seated scholar holding a vertical string instrument, seated on the rocky terrace facing forward-left.
must_preserve: calm frontal face and mustache linework
vertical instrument neck and rounded body
flowing pale robes with ink folds
dark seat and small ground objects near the feet

motifs.name: right_cascade_stream_and_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow stream and waterfall descending along the right side, with rounded boulders and rippling water bands.
must_preserve: ochre wash in the water channels

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_terrace_with_bamboo
motifs.description: Isolate the lower rocky terrace and ravine foreground beneath the figures, including layered stone shelves, dotted ground edges, sparse grasses, and bamboo-like shrubs.
must_preserve: gray-brown wash and angular rock hatching

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
